L3 · Brand colors

Six ways to wear red

The same system in every option: your hand logo as the profile picture, the same nine posts, and an LED title card. Only the colors change. Photos are toned to match each palette.

Jonathan's pick

5 · Red · Cream

Red, white and black are Coca-Cola's own colors. Shooting at Coke Studio in those, you read as part of their branding instead of your own. Cream breaks that, and its warmth matches the old-film horror look on ThrizzL3.

  • Grey options read flat on a phone and pull away from the party energy.
  • Black still shows up in your photos and shadows. It just isn't a brand color.

What this changes

Whichever you pick sets the colors for everything else: the profile picture, cover templates, title cards, and the LED loops. The black-and-white horror loops stay black and white, with your pick as the accent.
